title: The 3 largest of 9
notes: A = 5 12 3 18 7 21 9 14 2 and k = 3. The first three fill the heap, and 3 rises to the root. Then 18, 7, 21 and 14 each beat the root and push out 3, 5, 7 and 12; 9 and 2 lose to the root at once. The heap ends with 14 at the root and 21 and 18 below it: 16 comparisons, against 24 to sort everything and 23 for quickselect.
